title: Palmer Road Sports Hub (Hampshire County Council on behalf of Arun District Council)
description:
This was undertaken by Hampshire County Council on behalf of Arun District Council: Arun District Council seeks to appoint a consultant to lead the design and consultancy services associated with of a new Sports Hub at Palmer Road Recreation Ground in Angmering. 
The council's Playing Pitch Strategy undertaken in 2019, identified the need to upgrade and improve the current provision of pitches and changing facilities. Alongside investment from the Football Foundation, Palmer Road Recreation Ground is redeveloped as a multi-sport hub with improved grass pitches, changing facilities and a new 3G pitch. title: Combined Cleansing Services Contract  - Arun District Council  - AWARD
description:
Arun District Council (ADC) serves a population of approximately 160,000 residents under the West Sussex County Authority area with an increase of circa one thousand households per year over the course of the initial term. The authority provides kerbside residential waste (residual, recycling, and garden waste) collection services as well as street, beach and promenade cleaning and public toilet cleansing services to the popular tourist destinations of Bognor Regis, Littlehampton, Arundel and Rustington, which see approximately four million visitors a year.  
      
      This project is for the provision of the following services across Arun District Council land and properties: 
      Fortnightly residual waste from a 180-litre supplied bin. 
      Fortnightly dry mixed recycling from a 240-litre supplied bin - household. 
      Garden waste collection - household - the customer subscriber service aspect of the garden waste service will be moved in house to align with the other waste services.  
      Weekly Food waste - household 
      Bulky waste service - household 
      Neighbourhood Recycling centres 
      Street cleansing and litter picking  
      Highways cleansing and litter picking 
      Graffiti and Fly-Posting removal service 
      Cleansing and minor repairs of toilets (public conveniences) 
      
      The Contract will commence on 1st February 2026 and will be for a period of eight years with the option to extend for a further eight years.
      
      Interested parties should register their interest in the project via the In-Tend website https://in-tendhost.co.uk/hampshire, and complete and submit the tender return document together with any supporting information requested by 14.00 hrs on Monday 27th January 2025.

description:
Arun District Council is seeking proposals from qualified and experienced organisations for the development of two strategies. A housing strategy and a homelessness and rough sleeping strategy.

The Housing Strategy should set out our vision for housing in Arun from 2024 to 2028 and provide a clear and robust plan for meeting the housing needs of the local community, taking into account the changing demographic and economic circumstances of the area. 
The Homelessness and Rough Sleeping Strategy should provide a clear direction for the Council and its partners in tackling homelessness and rough sleeping in the district from 2024 to 2028.

title: Arun District Council  - Procurement of Microsoft Express Route Solution
description: As per ICT Strategy, we are entering the next phase of Arun's transition to MS Azure; this will include migrating line of business applications. To ensure these systems do not suffer any loss in performance or service levels we are looking to install a MS Express Route. This solution gives you a dedicated connection into Azure instead of using our existing Internet Connection, this will increase bandwidth throughput, whilst providing a more consistent and secure network experience than internet-based connections. The solution will include 2 circuits towards MS Azure into the same Cloud PoP on diverse routes, we intend to start with a 200Mb connection with the ability to increase this up to 1Gb if required with no additional charges except the cost of the additional bandwidth. We will also be taking a managed router option as part of the solution to minimise our management of the complexities of the ExpressRoute configuration.

title: MSDC - West Sussex Wellbeing Service Collaborative - Falls Prevention Exercise Service - AWARD
description:
West Sussex Wellbeing Service Collaborative includes the following Wellbeing services based out of local district and borough authorities funded by West Sussex County Council (WSCC) Public Health: 
      o Mid Sussex District Council (Procurement collaborative lead) 
      o Chichester District Council
      o Arun District Council
      o Adur & Worthing District Councils
      o Horsham District Council
      
      West Sussex Wellbeing is a countywide adult health improvement and prevention programme delivered at scale, addressing modifiable risk factors, and supporting wellbeing for all adults who live and/or work in West Sussex, with a focus on reducing inequalities.  
      
      The aim of this service is to develop and provide a coordinated countywide Falls Prevention Exercise Service for adults of all ages available across five Districts and Boroughs in West Sussex
      
      The Commencement Date for the delivery of the services is scheduled to be on 1 August 2023 at 00:00 hours.  The Contract will be awarded for a time period until 31 March 2027 (3 years, 8 months). Contract continuation is subject to performance and the absolute discretion of the collaborative.  
      
      The collaborative is procuring this contract following the Open Procedure under the UK Public Contract Regulations 2015 and Mid Sussex District Council's Procurement Code.  The collaborative will be awarding one Contract for the provision of all services detailed in the Specification. 
      
      The collaborative has a maximum budget of ?83,333.33 for the period between 1st August 2023 and 31st March 2024 & ?125,000 for each following year until contract end (2024/25, 2025/26, 2026/27) which must not be exceeded unless additional funding can be sourced.

title: Viticulture Economic Profile and  Viticulture Sector Business Insight Report (West Sussex)  - AWARD
description:
The Rural West Sussex Partnership is an informal economic partnership between The South Downs National Park Authority, West Sussex County Council, Arun District Council, Chichester District Council, Horsham District Council and Mid-Sussex District Council. Its primary role is to champion and support the rural economy across rural West Sussex. 
      Rural West Sussex Partnership (RWSP) identified the viticulture sector as a project topic for the 2022-2023 year.  
      In 2021 the South Downs National Park Authority Viticulture Growth Impact Assessment was produced which illustrated the rapid scale of growth of the viticulture sector in the National Park with a 90% increase in vineyard coverage in the South Downs National Park (SDNP) since 2016. There are now approximately 65 vineyards across West Sussex.
      Following the recently commissioned East Sussex Community Renewal Fund (CRF) viticulture project and the production of the Wine Tourism Investment Implementation Plan for Sussex 2022 to 2028 and accompanying Technical Report, RWSP wish to commission the production of both a Viticulture Economic Profile and a Viticulture Business Insight Report for West Sussex.
      This project is to be a complementary study to the CRF funded research undertaken in East Sussex. 
      This invitation to quote is for both the profile and insight report, as detailed below.
